def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # Rule: append (last * second_last) mod 11
    # Verified against all 12 training observations
    if len(state) >= 2:
        last = state[-1]
        second_last = state[-2]
        new_elem = (last * second_last) % 11
        return state + [new_elem]
    else:
        # Edge case: state with fewer than 2 elements
        return state
